claims.text: An unordered text document is one where sentences are not arranged in a specific order, often requiring structuring for applications like summarization and question answering.
Unordered text documents arise in real-world corpora, as evidenced by experiments conducted on Wikipedia documents where sentences were randomly rearranged.
